svg.title: Where domains and styles meet
svg.desc: 11 domains by 13 visual styles, colored by count among 1119 classified yes or likely files.
svg.text: 1,119 files labeled yes or likely · one classifier-assigned primary domain and style per file
Color and printed value both encode file count. Blank cells contain zero files in this retrieval.
This heatmap describes the retrieved files only. A file is not an independent creator or a verified Opus run.
Open the case atlas for pictured examples and the statistics page for method and denominator details.
